findings.body: The previous metadata defect remains open. Provider-confirmed selections update activity records here, but the lane keeps the initial `chosen` snapshot from review.py:509. The same problem affects worker.py:165 when a design worker falls back to Codex, and both reader paths at story.py:222–231 when settings are omitted. repo.py:411–419 allows an empty selection; confirmed settings at repo.py:278–283 and codex.py:384–386 update only activity records. Consequently, running entries in board JSON can report null or obsolete model and effort values. Refresh the shared lane entry when a provider confirms or changes its selection.
findings.title: Refresh lane metadata when the provider selects its model and effort

findings.body: The deferred integration remains outstanding. fasttest.py:271–272 launches tests directly, while review.py:279–288 uses the separate ticket queue; neither registers shared test entries. These selectors therefore cannot stop running or waiting tests, stop an item's worker and test together, or expose test output and progress in board JSON. plans/FORGE-LANES-1.md:142 assigns this integration and its command-level proofs to TESTS. Complete it there; this remains advice rather than an AGENTS blocker.
findings.title: Later: connect test entries and cancellation in TESTS
